name: ISM 27.12 MHz
description: Industrial heating; also overlaps CB and RC models.

name: 315 MHz Remote Control
description: Key fobs, garage doors and TPMS sensors in North America.

name: 433 MHz Part 15 Devices
description: Imported sensors and remotes; in the US this is inside the amateur 70 cm band, not an ISM band as it is in Region 1.

name: 902-928 MHz ISM
description: LoRa, Z-Wave (908.42), smart meters, cordless phones and RFID.

name: 2.4 GHz ISM
description: Wi-Fi 802.11b/g/n/ax, Bluetooth, Zigbee and microwave ovens.

name: Bluetooth
description: 79 channels of 1 MHz (classic) or 40 of 2 MHz (BLE); frequency hopping.

name: U-NII-1 (5.2 GHz Wi-Fi)
description: Wi-Fi channels 36-48; indoor and outdoor since 2014.

name: U-NII-2A (DFS)
description: Wi-Fi channels 52-64; dynamic frequency selection required (radar).

name: U-NII-2C (DFS)
description: Wi-Fi channels 100-144; DFS required to protect weather radar.

name: U-NII-3 (5.8 GHz Wi-Fi)
description: Wi-Fi channels 149-165; also 5.8 GHz ISM devices.

name: 6 GHz Wi-Fi (U-NII-5 to 8)
description: Wi-Fi 6E and 7; low-power indoor and standard-power AFC.

name: 24 GHz ISM
description: Doppler motion sensors and short-range radar.

name: Ultra-Wideband
description: UWB ranging and radar; very low spectral density.
